segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus sat with his disciples on the Mount of Olives, telling them what the long road ahead would hold —

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: wars, rumors, hardship, and patience under strain.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then he turned to the one thing that would outlast all of it:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a message carried to every corner of the earth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not a secret kept for a few.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A witness given to all nations — the good news of the kingdom going out until the very end.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The task he gave is still the task we carry: tell it, show it, live it — until the promise is fulfilled.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The good news was meant for the whole world — and for you. Come, hear it, and carry it on.
